rows.answer: The rule is threshold-driven, not calendar-driven. As of 2023-06-13 QQQ's Panic Index closed at 12.29 (VIX 14.61, Fear & Greed 79.63, 'extreme greed'), a 0.6 percentile, so the greed regime (below 15) is in force and the latest action was a reduce of 10%, leaving 30%. Two trigger paths from here: a close below 15 on the next observation reduces 10% again, continuing until the 0%; a close above 64 flips to panic and adds 20% per panic day, capped at 100%. Anything between 15 and 64 changes nothing, so the rule holds 30%. Note that in the standard window (2021-05-17 to 2023-06-13) Buy & Hold returned 13.38% versus 5.31% for the strategy, with average exposure of 91%.
key_reasons: Panic Index 12.29 on 2023-06-13 sits below the 15 greed threshold, so the rule reduced 10% to 30%.
A further close below 15 would cut another 10%, down to the 0%; a close above 64 would switch to panic and add 20% per day up to the 100%.

The most recent FOMC statement available as of 2023-06-13 (statement-20230322) left the target range at 4-3/4 to 5 percent and said 'some additional policy firming may be appropriate', a backdrop not directly wired into the index rule.

rows.answer: As of 2025-03-06, QQQ sits in the panic regime: the Composite Panic Index is 65.75 (90.4th percentile), with VIX at 24.87 and CNN Fear & Greed at 17.2 ('extreme fear'), just above the 64 buy threshold. Historically, panic-regime days have been modestly favorable for adding over short horizons: 104 completed instances show a 64.4% win rate and +0.91% mean return at 5 days and 66.3% / +2.4% at 21 days, but only 43.3% / -1.0% at 63 days, so the edge fades beyond a month. The rule is already at the panic-regime ceiling and holds 100% exposure today — no add occurred. Note that across the backtest window the strategy returned 15.23% versus 54.09% for Buy & Hold, and 100% is fully invested now. Historical research, not investment advice.

rows.answer: The rule moves only on regime thresholds, evaluated on the Panic Index (VIX 50% + inverted CNN Fear & Greed 50%). As of 2023-06-16 QQQ sits at 9.37 (0.2nd percentile), deep in the greed regime below the 15 sell line, with VIX 13.54 and Fear & Greed at 81.26 (extreme greed). The latest observation was a reduce: exposure fell by 10% to 0%, hitting the 0% floor. Going forward, another close below 15 would try to reduce 10% again, but exposure is already at the floor so nothing can be removed; a close above 64 would be the panic regime and add 20% toward the 100% ceiling. So only a genuine panic spike lifts exposure from here. Note Buy & Hold beat the strategy over the standard window (14.83% vs 5.73%), with upside drag of 18.95pp outweighing the 10.47pp cushion.
key_reasons: QQQ Panic Index is 9.37 at the 0.2 percentile, classified greed because it is below the 15 sell threshold.
The latest observation was a reduce, moving exposure from 10% down to 0% at the 0% floor.
Since exposure is already at the floor, further greed days cannot lower it; only a close above 64 (panic regime) would add 20%.
Over 2021-05-17 to 2023-06-16 Buy & Hold returned 14.83% versus the strategy's 5.73%, with average exposure of 90.5%.
